title: VoteGA local official (current board)
schemaStability: Stable field names and meanings. The current board is the rows holding a seat on `metadata.asOf`; a member staged to take office later is not in it. A blank value is null, never an empty string. Contact fields (email, phone) appear in this file only. New fields are appended, never reordered.

seat_id.description: stable seat key; every holder of a seat, past and present, shares it

seat.description: display label of the seat (may be reworded over time; seat_id never is)

name.description: name as the body styles it

title.description: verbatim office label when a body uses a distinctive one

party.description: party on a partisan seat; null for nonpartisan municipal seats

takes_office.description: ISO date the person began holding the seat; null = held before recording began

leaves_office.description: ISO date the hold ENDS, exclusive (first day they no longer hold it); null = still holding

leave_reason.description: term-ended | resigned | removed | deceased; null while holding

last_elected.description: year of the election that seated them

term_end.description: year the current term ends; null when not established

source.description: primary-source URL a person confirmed the row against

status.description: null for a normal holder; "Suspended" = still legally holds the seat while an interim serves
